roles.name: DURIN Operator
roles.description: Read and operate payments, conversions, wallets and compliance (no admin)

manualSteps: Add the dashboard redirect URI (<dashboard-url>/callback) under Redirects in the WorkOS dashboard (no API for this in the SDK).
Configure the AuthKit sign-in methods and Required MFA policy for the environment.
Set WORKOS_API_KEY, WORKOS_CLIENT_ID and WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD in the API and dashboard environments.
Link the DURIN organisation: PUT /v1/auth/workos/organisation with the new WorkOS organisation id.

didit.note: Create these in the NEW Didit application (console or the Didit connector), then set DIDIT_WORKFLOW_KYB / DIDIT_WORKFLOW_KYC to the new ids and create a v3 webhook destination for status.updated.
